title: Fighters

active.title: No fighters yet
active.body: Fighters appear here after they accept your invitation. Invite a fighter by email to start.

ended.title: No ended relationships
ended.body: Relationships you or a fighter end are listed here, with the dates only.

unavailable.title: Fighters aren’t available yet
unavailable.body: Coaching fighters on SimpleFit opens once the coach data rules and what fighters agree to share are published. Nothing is hidden from you: there is simply nothing to show yet.

failed.title: We couldn’t load your fighters.
failed.body: Check your connection and try again.

privacy: You see only what each fighter agreed to share: name, username, place, level, stance and bouts. Never their weight, goals or account details.

invite.title: Invite a fighter
invite.lead: They get an email with a link. Only someone signed in with this email can accept, and nothing is shared until they do.

email.label: Email
email.own: You can’t invite your own address.

note.label: Note · optional
note.help: Up to 500 characters, shown in the email.
note.invalid: Keep the note to one paragraph of up to 500 characters.

sent.title: Invitation created
sent.body: We’re emailing {email}. The link works for 14 days; you can resend or cancel it from Invitations.

existing.title: Already invited
existing.body: An invitation to {email} is still pending. You can resend it from Invitations.

invite.limited: You’ve sent a lot of invitations. Try again in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
invite.pendingLimit: You have 50 pending invitations. Cancel some before inviting more.
invite.failed: We couldn’t send the invitation. Nothing was created. Try again.

blocked.title: Inviting isn’t available yet
blocked.body: Inviting fighters needs the coach data rules, which aren’t published yet. You’ll be able to invite as soon as they are.

cancelInvitation.title: Cancel this invitation?
cancelInvitation.body: The link in the email to {email} stops working. You can invite them again later.
cancelInvitation.failed: We couldn’t cancel the invitation. Try again.

results.cooldown: You can resend in {seconds, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}}.
results.noResends: No resends left for this invitation.
results.notPending: This invitation was already answered or has expired.

never.title: Never shared with coaches
never.body:
Weight, height, goals and next fight
Account name, date of birth and email
Anything shared with other coaches

later.title: Sessions and notes arrive later.
later.body: Planning sessions with a fighter comes with its own feature.

unavailable.title: This fighter isn’t available
unavailable.body: The relationship may have ended, or the link is not one of yours.

endDialog.title: End your relationship with {name}?
endDialog.body: You lose access to {name}’s profile at once. To work together again, {name} has to accept a new invitation.
endDialog.failed: We couldn’t end the relationship. Nothing changed. Try again.
